changes.title: Sen. Amy Klobuchar wins DFL primary in Minnesota governor's race, CBS News projects
changes.summary: CBS News projects Sen. Amy Klobuchar, the heavy favorite, will win the Democratic primary in Minnesota's gubernatorial race and will face the Republican challenger in November.

changes.title: Sen. Amy Klobuchar to face Lisa Demuth in Minnesota gubernatorial general election
changes.summary: Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar and Republican Minnesota state House Speaker Lisa Demuth address their supporters after winning their respective primaries for Minnesota governor.

changes.title: Trump-backed Mike Lindell loses primary for Minnesota governor to Lisa Demuth
changes.summary: Lindell had President Trump's endorsement but he lost to Lisa Demuth, the speaker of the state house. She'll face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in the fall for governor. (Image credit: Ellen Schmidt).
